Basics

Avocado and salmon spread

Avokádós hal

8 months+ Adjusted 15 min 2 portions

From 8 months, the same day it is made. Salmon is the default. If fish is new, try the first taste in the morning on a well day, then keep offering fish a few times a week once it is tolerated.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 1/2 ripe avocado (mashed the day it is eaten)
  • 20 g boneless cooked salmon (the usual fish; skin and bones removed; fully cooked)
  • 15 g optional tuna canned in water (no salt added; occasional only, instead of salmon)

Allergens

fish

Method

  1. Cook a small piece of boneless salmon until it flakes and no translucent part remains.
  2. Check again and remove any bone or skin.
  3. Mash the avocado until smooth.
  4. Stir in a little salmon, or occasionally tuna canned in water with no salt added.
  5. Thin with a few drops of water if the mash is stiff.
  6. Serve the same day, with no mayonnaise.

Adjusted

Tuna is saltier and higher in mercury than salmon, and mayonnaise does not belong in the mash.

Mash ripe avocado with a small amount of boneless cooked salmon, using tuna canned in water with no salt added only now and then. Serve it the same day.
